snippet.title: Death Howl | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🦌#DeathHowl launches tomorrow - December 9 on PC, wishlist now: https://re.11bits.com/cri

Step into Ro’s journey through a sorrow-soaked spirit world, where every choice shapes your deck, your path, and your survival.

Turn-based combat, grid-bound tactics, and a haunting story of a mother searching for her son.
The hunt begins soon 🌲 

🧡Console versions are coming February 19, 2026

Music by: @offermose  https://offermose.bandcamp.com
